items.title: Meshy wants AI for 3D creation to feel less like a prompt and more like a creative partner
items.excerpt: Rather than a one-shot generator, Meshy's new conversational 3D Agent keeps context across a chat so game artists can brainstorm, iterate, and batch-build style-consistent asset families before exporting production-ready, riggable models into existing pipelines -- positioning generative 3D as a creative collaborator rather than a prompt box.

items.title: "Steam's required AI disclosure is the right move": devs say gen AI should be called out in games
items.excerpt: Developers back Valve's mandate requiring generative-AI content to be disclosed on Steam store pages, saying gen AI shipped in a game should be flagged to players and wishing every storefront would adopt the same rule.

items.title: Steam Week in Review: more than half of Steam games could carry an AI disclosure by 2027-2028
items.excerpt: Steam AI-disclosure rates have climbed from 10.9% of releases in 2024 to 30.8% so far in 2026; on trend, over half of new Steam games could be AI-flagged by 2027-2028 -- a concrete measure of how fast generative AI is being folded into game production. Weaker craft hook (an adoption stat), included as funnel context.
